liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Bertha into Promised Land opener raging [9]
- **One More Saturday Night** (1 review): Tight, unusual second-set opener of Saturday Night into Half-Step [9]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Estimated jam leads into drums, with Phil hinting at a Pink Floyd tune [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1992-02-22.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.96395.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 164 min; rated 3.2/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1992-02-22.150007.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 163 min [2]
- **gd1992-02-22.149848.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 163 min [3]
- **gd1992-02-22.138245.schoeps-cmc4-mk21.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.sbeok.flac16**: audience recording; 20 songs; 166 min [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1992-02-22.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.96395.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [1]
- **gd1992-02-22.150007.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 8, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [2]
- **gd1992-02-22.149848.sbd.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 8, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [3]
- **gd1992-02-22.138245.schoeps-cmc4-mk21.gastwirt.miller.sirmick.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Rick Gastwirk; transferred by SIRMick and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source: Audience recording > Schoeps cmc4 mk21 > Oade modified Panasonic SV-255 > Dat (48k); Fob recording by Rick Gastwirt; [4]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - February 23, 1992](https://www.dead.net/show/february-23-1992) [22]
